name: antikythera-proto
description: Antikythera's header-only wire formats (src/proto/ and the src/common/ wire and CRC32C helpers they use): hold wire versions 1 and 2, VolumeLayout, ReplicaConfig, reports and the signing test vectors. Consumed by kythira's khold module (.kiro/specs/khold-block-service/ Requirement 1.4) and later the EC2 module, exported as antikythera::proto. Header-only: nothing is compiled.
